name: openbb_cash_flow
description:
Cash flow statements (operating, investing, financing cash flow, free cash flow) for one company through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.cash).
Returns: {symbol, statements: [one record per period with period_ending, fiscal period and the line items]}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; period (annual or quarter; default annual); limit (number of periods; default 5); provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp, intrinio, polygon, sec, yfinance; default yfinance, no key).
Related: openbb_income_statement, openbb_balance_sheet; other sources: yf_cash_flow, av_cash_flow. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "period": "quarter", "limit": 4, "provider": "yfinance"}
